key_points: Cost per million tokens falls 34 percent against the model it replaces.
Throughput on commodity CPUs is 2.1x the previous release.
Weights are published under a permissive licence.
summary: Example Lab released a smaller model, claiming a 34 percent lower cost per million tokens and 2.1x the throughput of the model it replaces on commodity CPUs. The weights are published under a permissive licence.
title: Example Lab publishes smaller inference model under a permissive licence
